name: books/section-index
title: Index of the section
description: An index of the posts of the section, made by the module of the index: put it in a template or the content of the section, with the block that merges the units. In print each entry has the numbers of its pages; elsewhere it is a list of links. Choose what it lists with include and exclude (kind:place, source:image, visibility:print); a broader topic (the parent category, the country) gets a line of its own with the pages of everything below it through rollup (kind:place, kind:other, kind:any, or all); several blocks give several indexes.
